# Four new OpenAI-source adaptations

OpenAI math source snapshot: adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a. These sources were inspected, not freshly compiled or instantiated in Lean.

| Source family | Concrete sufficient construction | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Analysis/Cotype/RankFactors | Extract an independent sector, reconstruct the exact requested row map there, retain arbitrary-dirt rows outside it | Selected construction; 56 pairs of recursive calls fused, full replay passed |
| UniformKServer/TreeRounding and RoundingKernel | Jointly repair several owner bins while preserving role identities, invocation marginals, capacities and explicitly charged parked mass | 200,000 strict-repair triples plus a bounded neutral sweep found no improved full leftover profile |
| Probability/SwitchChain/FourVertexSwitch and PairTradeSwitch | Switch Y-borrowing output matchings and reconstruct their inverse basis/scatter | Inherited retiming was incompatible; 27 raw-frame candidates were legal but lost the paid moment |
| DukePrimeDegree/Geometry/RootCommutator | Reorder elementary shears with the explicit product-coefficient correction and pay every gate/frame change | Adjacent and 128-event windows found no lower-cost nominee; 603 candidate profiles on pair35 and 547 on the new provider |

The Cotype source proves exact rank-pairing factors and their contraction identity. Our coordinate-total construction is a separate finite row-sector adaptation; the source theorem itself is not a multiplication speedup. The initial displacement-kernel/telescoping idea was also screened and helped identify the small requested output space, but is not relabeled as the winning rank-factor theorem.

The minimum-retained-subset screen found that each block requires eight selected retired rows in the tested subset model, using modular exact rank checks. This does not rule out new linear combinations, altered packet construction or different interfaces. The successful universal moment inequality and full finite witness, not a barrier, are the result delivered here.

The other screens are bounded discovery evidence, not universal no-go results. Floating moment screens nominate or reject research candidates; only the selected full rational replay certifies the reported exponent. No approximate quantum operation, unconstructed decomposition, unpaid scalar correction or hypothetical solver is assumed.

PR517's exact packing ceiling freezes a different 84-pivot word and does not bound this 99-pivot rank-sector word. It usefully distinguishes a small allocation gap from a genuinely changed local construction. PR515 is an alternative bit-side method, not substituted for the stronger retained supplier. PR516 is draft formal realization context and does not remove our stated conditional assumptions automatically. PR511 updates provenance, not kappa. All are credited in SOURCES.json; unchanged public verifiers were not rerun.
